title: Configuration encoding bound
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, let $y$ be a finite Boolean string, and let $s$ be a natural number with $s\le 2|y|$. Write $H$ for the number of pairs consisting of an optional state of $N$ and an element of a three-element set, and set $W=H+3k+1$, where $k$ is the number of work tapes. If $b(y)=(8W+8)(|y|+1)$, then $|y|+2W(2s+1)+2(|y|+1)+4\le b(y)$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols
